integer_specialization_requires: All reachable inputs and intermediate results are integral
Bounds exclude overflow or explicitly reproduce JavaScript conversion semantics
Negative zero, NaN, infinity and coercion behavior are preserved wherever observable
preserve: Evaluation order and short-circuit operand values
Object identity, aliasing and mutation visibility
RNG algorithm, state and consumption order
Missing, undefined and null distinctions wherever observable

parallelism.independent_battles: Candidate if all mutable state including RNG is isolated
parallelism.simd_gpu_matrix: Candidate only with equivalent operation order, rounding and state visibility
parallelism.parallel_reductions: Require a separate equivalence argument; default disabled

transformation_record_requires: Source locations and supported execution domain
Semantic preconditions and evidence establishing them
Conservative fallback or explicit rejection when preconditions are unavailable
